songSearchEnable.name: songSearchEnable
songSearchEnable.label: Search on artwork click
songSearchEnable.description: Clicking the artwork opens the search URL below for the playing song.

songSearch.name: songSearch
songSearch.label: Search URL
songSearch.description: {query} is replaced with the playing artist and title.

useChannelLogos.name: useChannelLogos
useChannelLogos.label: Channel logos
useChannelLogos.description: Show channel logos instead of channel names in the channel list.

disableSettings.name: disableSettings
disableSettings.label: Hide settings
disableSettings.description: Remove the settings page and its button, so listeners cannot switch channels or stream quality.

hideBlurredArtwork.name: hideBlurredArtwork
hideBlurredArtwork.label: Hide blurred background
hideBlurredArtwork.description: Drop the blurred artwork behind the player for a cleaner look.

artworkAccent.name: artworkAccent
artworkAccent.label: Accent from artwork
artworkAccent.description: Tint the play button, volume bar and highlights with the current artwork's color.

artworkBackground.name: artworkBackground
artworkBackground.label: Background from artwork
artworkBackground.description: Tint the background gradient with the current artwork's color. Visible when the blurred background is hidden.
